decisions.why: examples (Selectomat SL, CIP-Adero, Duotherm II, Unotherm II) are steam sterilizers, matching the precedent for Steris's own 'Steam Sterilizers' division
examples (Vakulab PL/HL, Ventilab PL) are vacuum/pharma autoclave sterilizers for sterile processing

examples (UPL C-Shuttle automation system, Uniclean ML/PL II washer-disinfectors) are instrument washing and decontamination systems, matching the precedent for Steris's 'Washing And Decontamination Systems' division
same washer-disinfector product line as the 'Cleaning and disinfection' division (ampersand variant of the same division name, single product Uniclean PL II 15 Laboratory and Research)

examples (cleaning/packing tables and central dosing systems, Euro Clean Car transport trolley, SteriPack 88/95 sterile packaging systems) are sterile services department workflow accessories, matching the precedent for Steris's 'Sterile Processing Department Accessories' division — the RUMED label names a product line within MMM Group, not a different business

examples (EDScab 8H and Uniclean PLE 3 endoscope washer-disinfectors, Endo Admin software) are specifically endoscope decontamination equipment, matching the precedent for Steris's own 'Endoscope Reprocessing' division
Duotherm II / Unotherm II / Unotherm HL steam generators are ancillary plant supplying the same supplier's steam sterilizers
Batch Monitoring System and SteamSpy are sterilization process monitoring equipment, matching the precedent for Steris's 'Sterility Assurance And Monitoring' division
Hyper LTS 150 and Formomat PL are low-temperature sterilizers, the same sterile-processing equipment type as Steris's V PRO sterilizers (already mapped ssd:cssd)
RUMED360 is the management/documentation software for the same supplier's RUMED-branded sterile-processing equipment line
Vacudes PL is a hospital bed/trolley washer-disinfector — decontamination capital equipment within the scope of the framework this supplier is awarded on
